criteria.evidence: Model summary: stores/session.ts gains `pinned: PinnedRef[]` with togglePin/clearPins; idea-board.tsx 'stickers now push into the shared pin store (imageUrl: null) instead of local state'.
Backend PinnedRef { id, title, lane, image_url: str|None, source_url: str|None }; use-generate.ts converts camelCase store PinnedRef to wire contract; board pins with imageUrl: null.
pin-rail.tsx described as full-width bottom rail with '"N pins · conditioning input" label' and thumbnails; CSS in index.css in neutral palette (#f1f0ec).
pin-rail.tsx: 'Generate button with idle/generating/error states'.
pin-rail.tsx: 'absent at zero pins'.
'index.css — new rail/result styles reusing the existing workspace-enter/sticker-enter curves'; no dependency added (uv.lock/pnpm lock untouched).

api.py adds POST /v1/generate with GenerateRequest{session_id,transcript,pins} and GenerateResponse{image_url,prompt,model,reference_count} as Pydantic StrictModels; smoke-tested via curl in fixture mode.

synthesis.py SynthesizedPrompt only has Field(min_length=1, max_length=600); the 80-word bound is only in the instruction/description, not validated — a 90-word prompt under 600 chars would not be a validation error.
fal.generate(prompt=prompt, reference_urls=...) — arguments = {'prompt': prompt} (+image_urls); transcript never passed.
fal.py _submit POSTs to https://queue.fal.run/{model} with 'X-Fal-Store-IO': '0', then _await_completion polls status_url; no webhook.
_POLL_BUDGET_SECONDS = 45.0 with deadline check raising FalGenerationTimedOut; route returns 504 problem code 'generation_timed_out'.
_submit does a single client.post with X-Fal-No-Retry: 1 and raises FalUpstreamError on any failure; no retry loop.
httpx.Timeout(10.0) on submit, Timeout(5.0) on poll and result fetch; OpenAI client created with timeout=openai_request_timeout_seconds and wait_for wrapper.
fal.py uses plain httpx; `uv sync --frozen` succeeded with no lockfile drift.

_reference_urls filters https:// pins capped at settings.fal_max_reference_images; FalClient.generate picks fal_reference_model if reference_urls else fal_fallback_model, adding image_urls only when present.
pin_titles=[pin.title for pin in payload.pins] passed to synthesize_prompt; reference_count=len(reference_urls); generation-result.tsx renders 'no reference images' when 0.
FalClient.begin raises FalAlreadyGenerating under a lock; route returns 409 problem code 'generation_in_progress'; lru_cache single client.
config.py adds fal_key, fal_reference_model='fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext/max/multi', fal_fallback_model='fal-ai/flux/schnell', fal_max_reference_images=4 matching .env.example.
demo_mode == 'fixture' short-circuits to _fixture_generate with embedded data-URI PNG; curl smoke test 'no network'.
generation-result.tsx renders and the verbatim prompt with model id and reference count; wired into workpane.tsx.
PinRail is a fixed bottom rail rendered in session-screen.tsx whenever pins exist, independent of workpane content.
Model: 'Generate button with idle/generating/error states and a correlation id on failure'.
'No key names in dist/' after grep; OpenAI and fal calls live in apps/api only.
ruff 'All checks passed!', mypy 'no issues found in 23 source files', pytest 33 passed, pnpm typecheck/lint/build reported passing on merged main.
Typecheck passed under exactOptionalPropertyTypes; model fixed `className?: string | undefined`; no `any`/`!` visible in shown TS.
synthesis.py uses `except Exception as error`, fal.py uses typed httpx/ValueError excepts; no bare except.
Diff touches .env.example, apps/api, apps/web, packages/api-client only; no README.md or docs/ changes.
`uv run pytest -q` → 33 passed after changes.
session-screen.tsx: PinRail moved after the mic in markup; mic lifted via data-above-rail translateY(--mic-lift) so rail sits below it at the viewport bottom.
'.pin-rail is now a solid light banner (#f1f0ec, no blur)'.
'.pin-rail-unpin: the X unpin icon is now permanently visible on each thumbnail' and unpins on click.
Committed b3de91f on branch, `git merge --no-ff` into local main → 2172c52, checks re-run green, reported nothing pushed (no remote).

judge.reason: The replay delivered the pin rail, store lift, /v1/generate with fal queue client, fixture mode, result view, repositioned banner rail with X unpin, and merged locally into main with all checks green. It falls short on c4: the synthesis Pydantic schema only caps characters at 600 and does not enforce the under-80-word bound, so an over-length prompt is not a validation error as the criterion requires.
